title: Median price paid by ward, HPSSA Dataset 37
description: Median price paid for residential property by ward in England and Wales, quarterly from the year ending December 1995 to the year ending March 2023.

files.note: The year ending March 2023 edition, as published. Direct file: https://www.ons.gov.uk/file?uri=/peoplepopulationandcommunity/housing/datasets/medianpricepaidbywardhpssadataset37/yearendingmarch2023/hpssadataset37medianpricepaidbyward.zip It holds one file, "HPSSA Dataset 37 - Median price paid by ward.xls" (128 MB), so the archive is kept rather than the workbook: it is the published artefact and a third of the size. The loader reads sheet "1a" straight out of it.
